text.t:
Delicate and original, this 3D Christmas pinecone is a small detail that conveys all the magic and cosiness of this very special season.
Accompanied by a small white lacquered plywood tag with the message Merry Christmas, a delicate gold thread, and a wooden bead that completes the piece with a natural and elegant touch, it is perfect for decorating the Christmas tree or giving as a thoughtful keepsake.

gpsr.warnings.0.t: This is an ornament and not a toy: hang it out of reach of small children, who may put it in their mouths.
